title: Behavioral Consistency in Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.07581v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A trained model is usually described by its weights, as if the weights fixed its behavior. In practice the same weights are run by different programs. Training uses high-precision accumulation and fixed tensor shapes, while serving uses low-precision arithmetic, fused attention kernels, a paged key-value cache, and dynamic batching. These programs produce different next-token distributions from identical weights. We make this dependence explicit by indexing a policy by the kernel that executes it, and we propose kernel contracts, which state how far a serving kernel may drift from a reference kernel on each slice of traffic and what the serving system should do when a limit is exceeded. translated_title: 机器学习中的行为一致性
translated_abstract: 一个训练好的模型通常用其权重来描述，仿佛权重本身就决定了模型的行为。但在实践中，相同的权重会由不同的程序来运行：训练使用高精度累加和固定的张量形状，而推理服务则使用低精度算术、融合的注意力内核、分页键值缓存以及动态批处理。这些程序会从相同的权重中产生不同的下一个词元分布。我们通过用执行该策略的内核来对策略进行索引，使这种依赖关系显式化，并提出了“内核契约”，它规定了服务内核在每部分流量上相对于参考内核可以偏离多远，以及当超出限制时服务系统应当采取什么措施。我们证明了非渐近界，将两个内核之间的logit差异与总变差距离和KL散度、与期望奖励的变化、与基于另一内核生成的 rollout 所计算出的策略梯度的偏差联系起来……
tldr: 该论文指出模型行为不仅取决于权重，还取决于执行它的内核，并提出“内核契约”框架，通过非渐近理论界将内核间的logit差异与总变差、KL散度、期望奖励变化以及策略梯度偏差定量联系起来。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a model's behavior depends not only on its weights but also on the kernel executing it, and proposes "kernel contracts" with non-asymptotic bounds linking logit differences between kernels to total-variation/KL divergence, expected reward change, and policy gradient bias.
